title: An evening plan with the telescope
description: The weather and other conditions are shown hour by hour for the chosen place and target.

blocks.text: One verdict for the evening hides the useful windows. The observer has to decide when to get the equipment ready and what to expect.

quote.text: Wow. Looks cool. It’s total cloud cover and raining. The app shows it’s clear and dark. App says I should be outside in the rain with my telescope. Hahahaha. What a joke.

blocks.text: Show the figures separately and tie them to the plan. Let neighboring hours be compared and the chosen option saved.
Do not turn a forecast into a guarantee of visibility. It matters to show the uncertainty and the time of the update, not only a confident overall score.
